## Athletics

I competed as a national-level middle-distance runner with Atletica Mogliano between 2008 and 2018. That experience continues to shape my interest in sport data, longitudinal performance and the relationship between statistical evidence and decisions made by athletes and coaches. I hold an entry-level coaching qualification from the Italian Athletics Federation (FIDAL).

Outside the university, I am part of Padua’s running community: I run as a pacer with [Pole Run Club](https://linktr.ee/polebeer.runclub) and regularly participate in [Farfalle parkrun](https://www.parkrun.it/farfalle/).
